description: mod-finance-storage configuration template. Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment (tebfcon-mod-finance-storage revision 15, image 8.9.1); see ADR-0013 (Module configuration management). mod-finance-storage is an RMB (Vert.x) module: PostgreSQL settings are read by RMB, and Kafka is used only to publish fund and budget audit events. Resource values and JVM limits must be adjusted to the target host capacity.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-finance-storage container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-finance-storage container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-finance-storage container in MiB

java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum Java heap size. Value taken from bugfest; with MaxMetaspaceSize it leaves about 196 MiB of the container for non-heap memory

java.name: MaxMetaspaceSize
java.description: Maximum Java metaspace size. Value taken from bugfest

java.name: MetaspaceSize
java.description: Initial Java metaspace size (threshold for the first metaspace GC, not a limit). Value taken from bugfest

deployment.description: All state is in PostgreSQL and the audit outbox is drained with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, so replicas can run side by side. The only in-memory state is a short-lived settings cache. Two replicas are recommended for availability.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient for mod-finance-storage, including batch transaction and rollover endpoints.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL host (primary, read-write).

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL port.

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL user (from the secret store); needs rights to create tenant schemas.

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL password (from the secret store).

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database holding the per-tenant mod-finance-storage schemas.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum connections per tenant pool (RMB). Value taken from bugfest; RMB default is 4.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: When set, all tenants share one RMB connection pool of this size instead of per-tenant pools.

EnvVars.name: DB_CONNECTIONRELEASEDELAY
EnvVars.description: Idle time in ms before RMB closes a pooled connection (RMB default 60000; 0 keeps connections open).

EnvVars.name: DB_MAX_LIFETIME
EnvVars.description: Maximum lifetime of a pooled connection in ms (RMB default 1800000).

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of reconnect attempts on connection failure; when unset the Vert.x default (0) applies.

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTINTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Interval in ms between reconnect attempts; when unset the Vert.x default (1000) applies.

EnvVars.name: DB_EXPLAIN_QUERY_THRESHOLD
EnvVars.description: Queries slower than this many ms are logged with EXPLAIN ANALYZE. Value taken from bugfest; RMB default is 1000.

EnvVars.name: DB_ALLOW_SUPPRESS_OPTIMISTIC_LOCKING
EnvVars.description: Timestamp until which clients may suppress RMB optimistic locking (for data migration); unset means never.

EnvVars.name: DB_SERVER_PEM
EnvVars.description: PEM certificate of the PostgreSQL server; when set, connections use TLS.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST_READER
EnvVars.description: Optional read-only replica host for synchronous reads; unset means all reads go to DB_HOST.

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT_READER
EnvVars.description: Port of the read-only replica; defaults to DB_PORT.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST_READER_ASYNC
EnvVars.description: Optional asynchronously replicated read-only host for lag-tolerant reads.

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT_READER_ASYNC
EnvVars.description: Port of the asynchronous read-only replica.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker host for fund and budget audit events (module default 'kafka'). Not set in bugfest, whose 8.9.1 image predates these events.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port.

EnvVars.name: MAX_REQUEST_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum size in bytes of a produced Kafka record (producer max.request.size).

EnvVars.name: REPLICATION_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Passed to the Kafka config but currently unused: the module does not create its topics.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PRODUCER_TENANT_COLLECTION
EnvVars.description: Enables tenant collection topics ({ENV}.Default.{value}.{EVENT}); must match [A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,30}. Value taken from bugfest; unset means per-tenant topics.

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Environment name: Kafka topic prefix and first segment of secure store keys (module default 'folio').

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: Passed to the Kafka config but currently unused; outgoing calls use the x-okapi-url request header.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options; the only variable read by run-java.sh in the folioci/alpine-jre-openjdk21 image (JAVA_OPTS is ignored).

EnvVars.name: LOG4J_CONFIGURATION_FILE
EnvVars.description: Path or URL of an external Log4j2 configuration overriding the bundled log4j2.properties.

EnvVars.name: loadReference
EnvVars.description: Default for loading reference data on tenant init; the loadReference tenant parameter takes precedence.

EnvVars.name: loadSample
EnvVars.description: Default for loading sample data on tenant init; the loadSample tenant parameter takes precedence.

EnvVars.name: FINANCE_STORAGE_CACHE_SETTINGS_EXPIRATION_TIME_SECONDS
EnvVars.description: Expiration in seconds of the in-memory finance settings cache (Spring property finance.storage.cache.settings.expiration.time.seconds).

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Secure store for exchange rate API credentials: EPHEMERAL (default; credentials kept in the DB), AWS_SSM, VAULT or FSSP.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_REGION
EnvVars.description: AWS region of the SSM client; required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM
EnvVars.description: Use the task IAM role for SSM instead of explicit credentials.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT
EnvVars.description: HTTP endpoint for AWS credentials; ignored when SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM is true.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path appended to SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_TOKEN
EnvVars.description: Vault token; required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=VAULT.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_ADDRESS
EnvVars.description: Vault address; required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=VAULT.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_ENABLE_SSL
EnvVars.description: Use SSL when connecting to Vault.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_PEM_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: X.509 PEM certificate used to verify Vault over SSL.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password of the Vault client JKS keystore.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_KEYSTORE_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: JKS keystore with the Vault client certificate and key.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: JKS truststore with trusted Vault server certificates.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_ADDRESS
EnvVars.description: FSSP service URL; required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=FSSP.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_SECRET_PATH
EnvVars.description: FSSP path where secrets are stored (library default secure-store/entries).

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_KEYSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Key store file for the FSSP client.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_KEYSTORE_FILE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Type of the FSSP key store file.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password of the FSSP key store.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Trust store file for the FSSP client.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Type of the FSSP trust store file.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password of the FSSP trust store.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the sidecar container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the sidecar container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the sidecar container in MiB

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Deployment environment identifier. Must match the module's ENV.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: JVM options for the sidecar process.

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the backend module the sidecar fronts.

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL (host:port) of the mod-finance-storage container; the port must match the module's -Dhttp.port.

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of mod-finance-storage deployed alongside this sidecar.
